descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Leeds puts you in the captain's seat over the real Yorkshire.

THE REAL LEEDS
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Town Hall's clock tower, the Civic Hall's golden owls, the Corn Exchange, Kirkgate Market, the Minster, Bridgewater Place, Altus House and the Arena Quarter, the Royal Armouries, the Parkinson tower, Elland Road and Headingley.

YORK AND THE DALES
York Minster and Clifford's Tower, Knaresborough's viaduct over the Nidd, Harrogate, Ripon, Fountains Abbey, Brimham Rocks, Bolton Abbey, Skipton Castle and the Cow and Calf on Ilkley Moor.

THE WEST RIDING
Bradford's City Hall and Lister Mills, Saltaire, Halifax's Piece Hall and Wainhouse Tower, Huddersfield's Castle Hill, the Emley Moor mast and Drax's cooling towers.

A LIVING COUNTY
Trains on their real tracks, traffic on the left on the real roads. At night the Town Hall, the Arena, Elland Road and Emley Moor light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar at Aire Park, the city out of the doors. Repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
City approach, Vale of York approach, a sunset hop, the Aire Valley run, the Arena Quarter, York and the Dales, a Topcliffe scramble, Leeds by night, a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
